name: nursing-shift-handover
description: Write a nursing shift handover for a ward, unit or community caseload in ISBAR order, patient by patient, with the sickest first, outstanding tasks timed and owned, and the risks the next shift must watch. Use when asked to write my handover, structure a shift report, prepare bedside handover notes, hand over my patients, or tidy these handover notes. Produces a prioritised handover sheet per patient, a ward-level watch list, and a list of tasks due in the next shift. Distinct from clinical-case-summary, which presents one case in depth.
